text:
maria: Heads-up: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/12876 is blocked on an architecture note. Can someone attach the RFC or a short arch summary?
kevin: Sorry, that should've been included. This PR wires prefix caching into routing and changes shard affinity. I'll post the RFC in a sec.
sasha: Thanks — can you also paste a 2-line SLO/latency impact summary? worried about tail p99 on small requests.
kevin: TL;DR: added per-tenant prefix cache with optional strong affinity. Expected median latency +5ms, p99 risk only if cache miss storms occur. Will fallback to no-affinity variant. RFC here: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/2026-prefix-cache-routing.md
oliver: Quick note — the affinity change could increase cross-host hot keys; suggest we add a cache-eviction knob and telemetry hook.
kevin: good call. added eviction flag and a metric (cache.hotkey_evictions) in the PR description.
jen: release question — we need a 1hr canary window and an explicit rollback plan before I can approve scheduling.
kevin: canary plan pasted in PR: 1) deploy to canary subset (5%) 2) run synthetic prompt storm for 10m 3) monitor p99 and evictions 4) rollback immediately on >10% p99 delta
sasha: I can give lightweight arch sign-off if ops-runbook + canary steps are in PR and you add a fallback policy in code that prefers no-affinity variant on overload.
kevin: added fallback policy; small code snippet in PR: 
```
if load > THRESHOLD: route = no_affinity_model
else: route = affinity_model
```
sasha: ok skimming now. a couple nits in the PR comments but nothing blocking. once those are fixed I can +arch-bless.
maria: tagging @sasha since this blocks other merges today — thanks for fast turnaround. :pray:
devops-bot: canary scheduled for 2024-04-12T15:20:00Z (5% traffic) — attach release ticket #RL-442 if you need tracking.
kevin: addressed the nits, replied to comments. requesting final arch bless.
sasha: +arch-bless :thumbsup: go ahead and merge after canary completes and metrics look good.
maria: perfect, thanks everyone — I'll follow up if any post-canary issues.
